title: 项目启动会如何对齐目的、成功标准和角色
topic: 项目启动会如何对齐目的、成功标准和角色

source.title: Planning Project Kickoff Meetings: Steps & Example Agenda
source.section: Project Kickoff Play: collaborator roles, project destination, and follow-up
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 来源为 Atlassian Project Kickoff Play。本课聚焦确定项目参与角色、定义愿景/使命/成功检验标准、共同确认并更新记录。练习人物和指标为模拟情境。
paragraphs: Before running this Play, identify your project sponsor, project leader, facilitator, core team, and stakeholders. (One team member might hold multiple roles.)
Project sponsor (or executive sponsor): The most senior stakeholder who has the most to gain or lose from your project’s delivery
Project leader: Sets the vision on what the team is delivering and why
Facilitator: Responsible for keeping the kickoff meeting flowing and focused
Core team: The people who do the project work
Stakeholders: Anyone with insights, information, feedback, or a vested interest in the project’s outcome

Bring together the project sponsor, leader, and facilitator to draft a project vision, mission, and mission tests in a collaborative document, such as a Confluence page, whiteboard, or Trello board. The rest of the project team will participate in a 5-minute silent pre-read of the project poster. Next, the team will revise these elements during the kickoff meeting:
Vision: Your “why,” or the impact your team will make when the project is completed. Why are you pursuing this project?
Mission: Your “what” and “how.” What are you trying to do? How will you achieve your vision?
Mission tests: Your “when.” What will it look like when this project is successful? These tests indicate if your mission is on track and create a shared definition of “done.”

This is the most important aspect of the project kickoff: rallying the team around a shared purpose that can inspire and guide them. Begin by sharing the initial vision, mission, and mission tests created before the kickoff. Then, break attendees into three groups: one for vision, one for mission, and one for mission tests. Give each group 20 minutes to refine the initial statements. Next, bring the group back together to present and discuss their revised statements. Make any agreed-upon changes, then vote to formally accept them for the project. You can (and should) refine these elements later in the project as you uncover new information.

Invite your project leader to close the meeting by thanking the group for their collaboration, providing any feedback or closing thoughts, and recapping the next steps. On your list of action items, assign a team member to update the project poster with your agreed-upon vision, mission, and mission tests.
As the project moves along, revisit these plans and your project post to document progress and make any needed adjustments.
translations: 开展项目启动活动前，先确定项目赞助人、项目负责人、主持人、核心团队和利益相关者。一名成员可能兼任多个角色。
项目赞助人（或高管赞助人）：对项目交付的收益或损失影响最大、最相关的高级利益相关者。
项目负责人：确定团队要交付什么，以及为什么要做。
主持人：负责让启动会议顺利进行并保持讨论聚焦。
核心团队：实际承担项目工作的成员。
利益相关者：对项目结果有见解、信息、反馈或利害关系的任何人。
召集项目赞助人、负责人和主持人，在协作文档中起草项目愿景、使命和使命检验标准。其余团队成员先静默阅读项目说明，再在启动会上共同修改这些内容：
愿景：项目完成后团队希望产生的“为什么”或影响。为什么要做这个项目？
使命：团队要做什么以及怎样做。你们要完成什么？如何实现愿景？
使命检验标准：项目成功时会是什么样子？这些标准用于检查使命是否按计划推进，并让团队对“完成”形成共同定义。
启动会中最重要的是让团队围绕共同目的协作。先展示会前草拟的愿景、使命和检验标准，再分组细化。每组用 20 分钟修改初稿，然后汇总讨论并投票正式接受；项目过程中发现新信息后，还可以继续调整。
请项目负责人结束会议，感谢团队，回顾后续步骤，并在行动清单中指定一位成员，把商定的愿景、使命和检验标准更新到项目说明中。
项目推进过程中，重新检查计划和项目说明，记录进度并作必要调整。

notes.phrase: project vision, mission, and mission tests
notes.meaning: 项目愿景、使命和使命检验标准
notes.explain: 愿景讲希望产生的影响；使命讲要做什么、如何实现；检验标准讲何时算成功。三者作用不同。
notes.example: Let’s draft the project vision, mission, and mission tests before kickoff.

notes.explain: Vision 不是任务清单，而是项目完成后希望带来的影响。
notes.example: Our vision describes the impact our team will make for new hires.

notes.explain: Mission tests 让团队说清怎样观察项目是否成功，减少各自对“做完”的不同理解。
notes.example: The onboarding checklist gives us a shared definition of done.

scenario.title: Aligning an employee-onboarding project
english: A team is planning a new onboarding program for customer-support hires.
People agree on the broad idea but disagree about the intended impact and what would count as “done.”
You suggest clarifying the project purpose, what the team will deliver, how success will be tested, and then confirming roles.
chinese: 团队正在规划新的客服员工入职项目。
大家大致同意方向，但对项目要产生什么影响、怎样算“完成”意见不同。
你建议先明确项目目的、交付内容、成功检验方式，再确认分工。

firstAttempt.prompt: 模拟情境：团队要启动一项客服入职项目。请用英文说明为什么先对齐项目目的、要做什么/如何做、怎样判断成功，再确认角色分工。
firstAttempt.sample: Could we first agree on the impact we want this onboarding program to have, what we’ll deliver and how, and what evidence will show it’s successful? Once we share those points, we can confirm who owns each part.
firstAttempt.rationale: 启动会先建立共同目的和完成标准，再确定角色，避免不同成员按不同的“成功”定义分头行动。

words.collocation: hold a kickoff meeting; project kickoff
words.example: We’ll hold a kickoff meeting before the onboarding project starts.
words.translation: 入职项目开始前，我们会召开启动会。
words.note: 通常在正式开始项目时召开，用来建立共同方向。

words.example: Our vision explains the impact we want to make for new hires.
words.translation: 我们的愿景说明希望为新员工带来什么影响。
words.note: 在本课来源中，vision 回答项目的 why。

words.meaning: 使命；要做什么以及如何做
words.example: The mission says what the team will deliver and how.
words.translation: 使命说明团队要交付什么以及如何交付。
words.note: 它把愿景变成要完成的工作方向。

words.meaning: 使命检验标准；成功判据
words.collocation: define mission tests; pass a mission test
words.example: Mission tests show what success will look like.
words.translation: 使命检验标准说明成功会是什么样子。
words.note: 用于判断项目使命是否按计划推进，并定义何时算完成。

words.example: Invite stakeholders who can affect or are affected by the project.
words.translation: 邀请能够影响项目或受项目影响的利益相关者。
words.note: 不仅是项目组成员，也包括对结果有利害关系的人。

words.collocation: align on a purpose; align on success criteria
words.example: Let’s align on what successful onboarding means before assigning owners.
words.translation: 分配负责人前，我们先对齐成功入职的定义。
words.note: align on 后接需要团队达成共同理解的内容。

structure.original: These tests indicate if your mission is on track and create a shared definition of “done.”
analysis: “These tests”指前面的 mission tests；主句用 indicate 表示这些标准能说明某事。
if 引导宾语从句，说明要检查的内容：使命是否在按计划推进。
“a shared definition of done”不是泛指进度，而是团队共同认可的完成标准。
structure.transfer: Our mission tests show whether new hires can complete the required customer-support tasks by the end of week two.

rewrite.bad: Let’s assign the tasks now. We can decide what success means after the project starts.
rewrite.good: Could we agree on the impact we want, what we’ll deliver and how, and what evidence will show success? Then we can confirm the owners.
rewrite.translation: 我们能否先明确希望产生的影响、要交付什么及如何交付，以及用什么证据判断成功？然后再确认负责人。
rewrite.pattern: Could we first agree on [the purpose / what and how / success test]? Then we can confirm [the roles].

cloze.prompt: A project vision describes the “why” or the ___ the team hopes to make.
cloze.why: Atlassian 对 vision 的定义是项目完成后希望产生的影响。

cloze.prompt: The mission explains what the team will do and ___ it will do it.
cloze.why: Mission 回答 what 和 how。

cloze.prompt: Mission tests create a shared definition of “___.”
cloze.why: 成功检验标准帮助团队对何时完成形成共同定义。

dictation.text: Mission tests: Your “when.” What will it look like when this project is successful? These tests indicate if your mission is on track and create a shared definition of “done.”
On your list of action items, assign a team member to update the project poster with your agreed-upon vision, mission, and mission tests.

translationPractice.prompt: 我们能否先对齐项目目的？
translationPractice.answer: Could we agree on the project’s purpose first?
translationPractice.why: 先明确项目为什么要做。

translationPractice.prompt: 项目成功时会是什么样子？
translationPractice.answer: What will it look like when this project is successful?
translationPractice.why: 用可检验的结果描述成功。

translationPractice.prompt: 之后我们再确认每部分由谁负责。
translationPractice.answer: Then we can confirm who owns each part.
translationPractice.why: 先建立共同方向，再确认具体角色。

choice.prompt: 哪项描述属于 Atlassian 所说的 mission test？
options: 项目完成后希望产生的影响。
团队要做什么以及如何实现愿景。
用来判断项目何时成功、建立共同“完成”定义的标准。
choice.why: Vision 是 why/影响；mission 是 what/how；mission tests 定义成功的可观察标准。

output.prompt: 新客户门户项目启动会上，团队希望减少重复咨询、但尚未约定门户要提供什么内容或怎样衡量效果。请用英文建议先对齐希望产生的影响、要交付什么以及成功标准，再确认负责人。
output.sample: Could we agree on the impact we want the customer portal to have, what self-service content we’ll deliver, and what success will look like—for example, fewer repeat support requests? Then we can confirm who owns each part.
check: 是否说明门户希望带来什么影响？
是否说清要交付什么内容？
是否提出可观察的成功标准？
是否把负责人确认放在共同目标之后？
